skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of E-commerce and its development stages, classify basic types of E-commerce
Apply knowledge and skills related to E-commerce in business (website management, electronic marketing, E-commerce strategy management...)
Understand the application of internet and network technology in E-commerce, information systems, and data in E-commerce
Analyze information related to E-commerce, macro and micro environments affecting E-commerce activities to develop business strategies and models
Manage E-commerce websites, platforms, and online stores
Understand and analyze applications of technologies in E-commerce (AR, VR, AI, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Blockchain...)
Develop communication skills through reading materials and group work
Self-study and research independently to enhance E-commerce expertise
Identify and solve practical issues in E-commerce
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations
Manage and present group projects on E-commerce activities and business models
Understand security and safety requirements in E-commerce transactions, manage risks in E-commerce
Understand and apply payment systems and technologies in E-commerce
Understand and apply marketing strategies in E-commerce
Understand the concept and models of Government E-commerce
